entities.summary: Masao Ohba  was a Japanese professional boxer. He became the WBA flyweight World Champion on October 22, 1970, defeating the reigning champion Berkrerk Chartvanchai in Tokyo and retained the championship for an impressive 5 title straight defenses. He died in a car accident at 23, still holding his world title. He was trained by Isamu Kuwata.He is Soh Ohba's uncle.Soh's adoptive father is Masao's younger brother, Isaburo Ohba, who is 5 years younger than him.
